fresh_generation_contract.owner: daemon or launch owner, not guest device code
required_path: MachineManager resolves the same production graphics authority and stages a new renderer bootstrap using the existing RawHVRendererBootstrapRequest invariants.
A restartable DesktopRendererWorkerLaunch/session API in dory-hv asks that owner for a new authenticated bootstrap when DoryPCMode sees a non-pristine reset.

The new generation must create a new DoryRendererWorkerBroker and DoryRendererWorkerVirtioCommandLane, verify live capability receipt, and publish updated rendererGeneration / receipt SHA / producer-fence proof for display readiness.
Old generation scanout leases and pending fences must be revoked before the replacement machine receives the fresh authority. Stale callbacks must remain generation-scoped.

implemented: Exposes replacement usability from the existing active state, without duplicating lifecycle state.
DoryPCMode refuses to construct a replacement accelerated DoryPC machine with a revoked renderer worker authority; it fails the lifecycle with an explicit fresh-generation-required error.
Focused tests assert pristine reset remains reusable and overflow/non-pristine reset marks the authority unusable.
not_completed: Fresh renderer worker generation after non-pristine guest reset is still not implemented.

The runner cannot mint a fresh worker from its current launch envelope because the daemon stages one unlinked inherited renderer-bootstrap descriptor, and DesktopRendererWorkerLaunch consumes it before startup.
notes: DoryPCMode hash includes root committed interrupt-progress diagnostics plus this reset guard if present in shared tree.
This is an interim fail-closed layer; fresh daemon-provisioned renderer generations remain required for working accelerated reset lifecycle.
scope: PC renderer reset lifecycle, first bounded fail-closed layer
